title: Ginger milk pudding
creator: herwellnessdiary_
steps: Grate fresh ginger and squeeze out about 1 tbsp juice into a bowl.
Stir the honey into the milk and warm it to about 70 °C (hot, not boiling).
Pour the warm milk into the ginger juice from a height, stir once gently and leave undisturbed for about 15 minutes until set.
